item.title: Ooni praises Fani-Kayode’s ambassadorial screening, thanks Tinubu for ‘honour to Ifeland’
item.description: Adeyeye Ogunwusi, the Ooni of Ife, has congratulated Femi Fani-Kayode, former minister of aviation, on his successful screening by the senate for an ambassadorial role. The monarch described the development as a worthy honour to the people of Ifeland and Osun state. item.title: EFCC arraigns Peace Corps commandant, finance director over alleged misappropriation
item.description: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arraigned Dickson Akon, the commandant of the Nigeria Peace Corps, and Omolala Aminat Ahmed, the organisation’s director of finance, before a high court in Abuja on charges of criminal conspiracy and misappropriation. item.title: ECOWAS Council of Ministers endorses Ghana’s President Mahama for AU Chair in 2027
item.description: The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Council of Ministers has endorsed Ghanaian President John Mahama as its sole candidate for chairperson of the African Union. Mr Mahama was chosen as the bloc’s candidate for chairperson of the African Union when the rotating chairmanship position reaches West Africa in 2027.
